en.title: Microsoft Foundry Lab Guide
en.description: An independent Microsoft Foundry lab guide covering models, knowledge, tools, evaluation, and operations through a synthetic Contoso purchasing assistant.
en.progress_hint: Check a module after meeting its success criteria.
en.offline_note:
Read the guide offline.
Azure labs need separate authentication and may incur charges.
en.hero_description:
One business agent connects the full lifecycle:
models, knowledge, tools, evaluation, safety, and operations.
en.reader_note:
A GA portal does not mean every feature is GA. Workflows is scheduled to retire on 2026-12-01. Core labs follow stable paths; advanced labs identify Preview features and support requirements.
English live validation is not release-approved: holdout 7/10, one critical safety citation-evidence failure. See the execution report.
en.cover_description: Models, knowledge, tools, evaluation, safety, and operations—connected through one purchasing and policy assistant
en.cover_edition: Contoso independent lab guide · English · 25 modules
en.duration: Core course: 5 hours 20 minutes, plus provisioning and breaks / Choose advanced modules as needed
en.cover_boundary: Keep GA/Preview, implementation, execution, and quality claims separate. See {validation}. These labs never place orders, take payments, or grant business approvals.
en.kit_note: Code and data are included in the workshop kit.

en.footer_title: What you learn and what has been verified are different.
en.footer_note: Synthetic Contoso data · Explicit Azure opt-in · GA/Preview boundaries
